name: yaropay
description: Open-source, self-hosted payment orchestration for companies that run several products on one gateway account

scripts.dev: npm run build:core && concurrently -k -n core,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @yaropay/core" "npm run dev -w @yaropay/api" "npm run dev -w @yaropay/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @yaropay/api && npm run build -w @yaropay/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
